qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Extensive global dealer and service network across commercial trucking and heavy equipment with strong total-cost-of-ownership (TCO) brand reputation, but cyclical truck replacement cycles and aggressive price discounting during freight downturns constrain pricing power, keeping consolidated GAAP ROIC in the 8-11% range.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 3b (ROIC & Pricing Power). Premier global commercial truck and heavy equipment OEM, but consolidated multi-cycle GAAP ROIC (including financial services) hovers at 8-11%, below the 12% threshold. Extreme cyclicality in freight fleets and fleet capex deferrals during downturns preclude sustained pricing power above inflation.
qualitative.evidence: Consolidated multi-cycle ROIC averages 8-11% across full cycles due to financial services leverage and cyclical troughs (e.g. 2020 ROCE dipped to 10.4%). While Industrial Operations delivers strong peak-cycle margins (11-14%), truck deliveries are subject to 20-30% cyclical contractions and multi-billion-euro dual powertrain (diesel and zero-emission) transition capex.
